description: Understand and optimize AMP query activity from CloudWatch query logs. Ranks queries, dashboards, rules and consumers by total samples scanned. Requires opt-in query logging.

options.content:
# Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus — Query Insights

Understand and optimize **query activity** against an **AMP** workspace using query logs shipped to **CloudWatch Logs**. Cost is driven by **`samplesProcessed`**, so every ranking uses **total samples (frequency × avg)** rather than average alone.

#### ⚠️ Prerequisites
1. Enable **query logging** on the AMP workspace with a CloudWatch Logs destination — panels are empty without it.
2. Point the **CloudWatch datasource**, **Region** and **Log group** variables at that log group.
3. Narrow with **Filter** (metric / label / value) and **Source** (API vs alerting vs recording).

Reference: [Optimizing queries with Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/mt/optimizing-queries-with-amazon-managed-prometheus/)

### What this answers
| # | Goal | Where |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Where is my query load going? | Query load distribution — volume over time by source |
| 2 | Which queries cost the most? | Top queries by total samples scanned |
| 3 | Which dashboards cost the most? | Dashboards ranked by total samples |
| 4 | What do alerting & recording rules cost? | Rules ranked by total samples |
| 5 | Which cost cannot be attributed? | Unattributed query cost (no dashboardUid) |
| 6 | What time ranges are queries requesting? | Longest-range queries (lookback window) |

> **Note:** `qspThreshold` in the query-logging configuration gates what gets logged — `0` logs everything. Check it with `aws amp describe-query-logging-configuration`. Both API queries (`component = query-frontend`) and AMP ruler evaluations (`component = ruler`) are captured. Attribution fields (`dashboardUid`, `panelId`, `userAgent`) are taken verbatim from request headers, so treat them as caller-supplied hints.

panels.description: Sum of samples across matching query patterns. This is the primary cost dimension.
panels.title: Total query samples processed

panels.description: Sum of frequency across matching query patterns.
panels.title: Total executions

panels.description: Max total_samples for a single (dashboard, panel, query) pattern. Top optimization target.
panels.title: Costliest pattern (samples)

panels.description: Distinct dashboards issuing matching queries. Counts only queries carrying a dashboardUid; rule evaluations and callers that omit X-Dashboard-Uid are excluded.

targets.expression:
fields case(component = "ruler" and message.ruleKind = "alerting", "alerting rule", component = "ruler" and message.ruleKind = "recording", "recording rule", component = "query-frontend", "API", "other") as source
| filter message.dashboardUid like /./ and message.query like /${filter:raw}/ and source like /${source:pipe}/
| stats count_distinct(message.dashboardUid) as dashboards

panels.title: Dashboards queried

panels.description: Most recent time any query matching the filter ran. A stale value means the metric/label has low recent query activity — a candidate for cleanup or tiering.

targets.expression:
fields case(component = "ruler" and message.ruleKind = "alerting", "alerting rule", component = "ruler" and message.ruleKind = "recording", "recording rule", component = "query-frontend", "API", "other") as source, toMillis(@timestamp) as ts
| filter message.query like /${filter:raw}/ and source like /${source:pipe}/
| stats max(ts) as last_queried

panels.title: Last queried (current filter)

panels.description: Executions per 30m bin by source. 'API' = anything served over the query API (Grafana dashboards, Explore, Grafana-managed alert rules, SDKs and agents). 'rule' = evaluated by the AMP ruler. Bars, not lines: Logs Insights omits empty bins.

targets.expression:
fields case(component = "ruler" and message.ruleKind = "alerting", "alerting rule", component = "ruler" and message.ruleKind = "recording", "recording rule", component = "query-frontend", "API", "other") as source
| filter message.query like /${filter:raw}/ and source like /${source:pipe}/
| stats count(*) as executions by source, bin(30m)

panels.title: Query volume over time (by source)

panels.description: Which clients drive cost. API traffic only (ruler events carry no userAgent). Treat this as a hint, not an identity: currently Grafana 9.4 and earlier send an identifiable `Grafana/<version>` agent (e.g. `Grafana/9.4.7`), while the newer AMP plugin sends Go's default `Go-http-client/1.1`, which is indistinguishable from SDKs and agents. Expected to change in a later plugin release - re-verify before relying on it.

targets.expression:
fields message.userAgent as userAgent, message.samplesProcessed as samples, case(component = "ruler" and message.ruleKind = "alerting", "alerting rule", component = "ruler" and message.ruleKind = "recording", "recording rule", component = "query-frontend", "API", "other") as source
| filter component = "query-frontend" and message.query like /${filter:raw}/ and source like /${source:pipe}/
| stats count(*) as executions, sum(samples) as total_samples, avg(samples) as avg_samples by userAgent
| sort total_samples desc
| limit 50

panels.title: Query cost by source (user agent)

panels.description: Share of total samples by source. 'API' covers all query-API traffic (dashboards, Explore, Grafana-managed alert rules, SDKs, agents); 'rule' is AMP-ruler evaluation only. Use the user-agent panel to separate interactive from programmatic within API.

targets.expression:
fields case(component = "ruler" and message.ruleKind = "alerting", "alerting rule", component = "ruler" and message.ruleKind = "recording", "recording rule", component = "query-frontend", "API", "other") as source, message.samplesProcessed as samples
| filter message.query like /${filter:raw}/ and source like /${source:pipe}/
| stats sum(samples) as total_samples by source

panels.title: Query samples processed by source

panels.description: Grouped by dashboard, panel, query and queryType. Ranked by total_samples (frequency x avg). High frequency + large scans = recording-rule candidates. Click DashboardUid to open it.

targets.expression:
fields message.dashboardUid as DashboardUid, message.panelId as PanelId, message.query as Query, message.queryType as queryType, message.samplesProcessed as samples, case(component = "ruler" and message.ruleKind = "alerting", "alerting rule", component = "ruler" and message.ruleKind = "recording", "recording rule", component = "query-frontend", "API", "other") as source
| filter message.query like /${filter:raw}/ and source like /${source:pipe}/
| stats count(*) as frequency, avg(samples) as avg_samples, max(samples) as max_samples, sum(samples) as total_samples, avg(message.step) as avg_step by DashboardUid, PanelId, Query, queryType
| sort total_samples desc
| limit 100

panels.title: Top queries by total samples scanned

panels.description: Total query cost aggregated per dashboard. Only queries that carry a dashboardUid are counted - rule evaluations and API callers that omit the X-Dashboard-Uid header are excluded rather than collapsed into one blank row.

targets.expression:
fields message.dashboardUid as DashboardUid, message.samplesProcessed as samples, case(component = "ruler" and message.ruleKind = "alerting", "alerting rule", component = "ruler" and message.ruleKind = "recording", "recording rule", component = "query-frontend", "API", "other") as source
| filter message.dashboardUid like /./ and message.query like /${filter:raw}/ and source like /${source:pipe}/
| stats sum(samples) as total_samples, count(*) as frequency, avg(samples) as avg_samples by DashboardUid
| sort total_samples desc
| limit 50

panels.title: Dashboards ranked by total samples

panels.description: Alerting + recording rules by cost. evaluations x avg samples = continuous cost. Unexpectedly large scans often mean a missing label filter. Ruler events only (component = ruler).

targets.expression:
fields message.ruleKind as RuleKind, message.ruleNamespace as RuleNamespace, message.ruleGroup as RuleGroup, message.ruleName as RuleName, message.query as Query, message.samplesProcessed as samples, case(component = "ruler" and message.ruleKind = "alerting", "alerting rule", component = "ruler" and message.ruleKind = "recording", "recording rule", component = "query-frontend", "API", "other") as source
| filter component = "ruler" and message.query like /${filter:raw}/ and source like /${source:pipe}/
| stats count(*) as evaluations, avg(samples) as avg_samples, sum(samples) as total_samples by RuleKind, RuleNamespace, RuleGroup, RuleName, Query
| sort total_samples desc
| limit 100

panels.title: Rules ranked by total samples

panels.description: Heaviest queries by total samples scanned.
panels.title: Top 15 queries by total samples

panels.description: API queries that carry no dashboardUid, so no dashboard or panel can be attributed. This is where most sample cost sits today. Ranked by total samples; max_samples shows the worst single execution. Populated by callers that omit X-Dashboard-Uid, including the newer AMP plugin.

targets.expression:
fields message.query as Query, message.userAgent as userAgent, message.samplesProcessed as samples, case(component = "ruler" and message.ruleKind = "alerting", "alerting rule", component = "ruler" and message.ruleKind = "recording", "recording rule", component = "query-frontend", "API", "other") as source
| filter component = "query-frontend" and not (message.dashboardUid like /./) and message.query like /${filter:raw}/ and source like /${source:pipe}/
| stats count(*) as executions, avg(samples) as avg_samples, max(samples) as max_samples, sum(samples) as total_samples by userAgent, Query
| sort total_samples desc
| limit 100

panels.title: Unattributed query cost (no dashboardUid)

panels.description: Range queries sorted by lookback (end - start). Long range + high samples = biggest cost drivers; a panel may be scanning weeks of data on every refresh.

targets.expression:
fields message.query as Query, (message.end - message.start) as range_lookback, message.step as step, message.samplesProcessed as samples, case(component = "ruler" and message.ruleKind = "alerting", "alerting rule", component = "ruler" and message.ruleKind = "recording", "recording rule", component = "query-frontend", "API", "other") as source
| filter message.query like /${filter:raw}/ and message.queryType = "range" and source like /${source:pipe}/
| sort range_lookback desc
| limit 100

panels.title: Longest-range queries (lookback window)

panels.description: Unaggregated CloudWatch Logs for the current filter, newest first. Expand any line to inspect every field. API events: queryType, start/end/step, userAgent, dashboardUid, panelId. Ruler events: ruleName, ruleKind, ruleGroup, ruleNamespace. Both: query, samplesProcessed, queryTimeInSeconds, component, workspaceId.

targets.expression:
fields @timestamp, @message, case(component = "ruler" and message.ruleKind = "alerting", "alerting rule", component = "ruler" and message.ruleKind = "recording", "recording rule", component = "query-frontend", "API", "other") as source
| filter message.query like /${filter:raw}/ and source like /${source:pipe}/
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 1000

panels.title: Raw query logs (expand a row for all fields)

list.label: Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus datasource
list.name: prom

list.description: Regex applied to message.query. Metric names from Prometheus by default; type a custom value for a label name or label-value pair. All = every query (.*).
list.label: Filter (metric / label / value)
list.name: filter

list.description: Filter by query origin. AMP ruler alerting / recording rule evaluations, vs API = served over the read API (Grafana dashboards, Explore, Grafana-managed alert rules, SDKs and agents).
list.label: Source
list.name: source
list.query: alerting rule, recording rule, API, other
